videos.title: Gemini's New Personal Agent Is Here (Muse Killer?)
summary: Paul J Lipsky takes a hands-on look at Google's newly rolled-out Gemini personal agent, which can now handle real-world tasks through ordinary text messages and email rather than requiring a dedicated app interface.

The video walks through who currently has access, how texting and task requests work, and how the agent manages email and payment-related actions, before pausing for a sponsored Semrush segment and returning to flag what Lipsky calls "the big issue" with the assistant in its current form.

He closes by showing how to set Gemini's agent up step by step, running through its features and limits, and ultimately comparing it head-to-head with Meta's Muse assistant to gauge which one is more capable right now.

videos.title: Claude Design is Shutting Down - Do This Now

Chapters cover the shutdown announcement, what's changing, moving projects over, and using the new design experience, continuing Futurepedia's pattern of practical, deadline-driven guides for navigating changes to popular Claude features.
